keep_inline_images_in naming 'a' keeps an image inside a link that also holds a block element

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<a href="https://example.com/file.pdf"><img src="pdf.png"><p>Download PDF</p></a>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(keep_inline_images_in: ['a']))
puts result.content.inspect
```
